new_entities.name: Levothyroxine for mild subclinical hypothyroidism with TSH 4 to 10
aliases: LT4 for subclinical hypothyroidism with TSH below 10
new_entities.description: Levothyroxine treatment for adults with persistent mild subclinical hypothyroidism, especially those with thyroid-stimulating hormone levels between about 4 and 10 mIU/L.

new_entities.name: Cardiovascular outcomes
new_entities.description: Composite or individual cardiovascular outcomes such as myocardial infarction, stroke, heart failure, atrial fibrillation, or cardiovascular death.

edges.effect_quant: In older adults with predominantly mild subclinical hypothyroidism, pooled randomized evidence has not shown a significant cardiovascular benefit from levothyroxine: the TRUST/IEMO80+ cardiovascular analysis found HR 0.74 for cardiovascular events with wide confidence intervals crossing no effect, while a broader mortality meta-analysis found no cardiovascular mortality reduction overall (RR 0.99) and no benefit in adults aged 65 to 70 years or older.
edges.population: adults with persistent mild subclinical hypothyroidism, especially older adults whose TSH is elevated but remains below 10 mIU/L
edges.mechanism: Levothyroxine could theoretically reduce cardiovascular risk by improving lipids, vascular tone, and myocardial thyroid signaling, but in mild subclinical disease the physiologic deficit may be too small for this to translate into fewer clinical events.
edges.summary: This edge is contested rather than clearly protective. Cardiovascular risk may be higher in untreated subclinical hypothyroidism at the population level, but treating the common mild TSH 4 to 10 range has not convincingly improved hard cardiovascular outcomes in older randomized cohorts.
edges.caveats: Any possible benefit may differ by age, baseline cardiovascular disease, symptom burden, and TSH severity. Signals suggesting mortality benefit in younger adults do not map cleanly onto the older, mostly mild subclinical hypothyroid populations studied in the best randomized trials.

evidence.notes: Levothyroxine Treatment and Cardiovascular Outcomes in Older People With Subclinical Hypothyroidism: Pooled Individual Results of Two Randomised Controlled Trials.

effect_quant.comparator: cardiovascular events with levothyroxine versus placebo in pooled TRUST and IEMO80+ participants

evidence.citation: PengCCH et al 2021 J Clin Endocrinol Metab
evidence.notes: Association of Thyroid Hormone Therapy with Mortality in Subclinical Hypothyroidism: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.

effect_quant.comparator: cardiovascular mortality with thyroid hormone therapy versus no therapy across adults with subclinical hypothyroidism

evidence.notes: Effect of Levothyroxine on Older Patients With Subclinical Hypothyroidism: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.

effect_quant.comparator: fatal or nonfatal cardiovascular events with levothyroxine versus control in older adults with subclinical hypothyroidism
